name: uzlegal-v1
description: Retrieval benchmark for Uzbek legal QA. Gold labels are derived from real article headings in the indexed corpus, so every in-scope question has exactly one provably correct article. Out-of-scope questions carry no gold and exist to measure refusal rather than recall.
gold_provenance: Article numbers and headings read directly from chunks.heading in the production corpus; questions were written from those headings, not the reverse.
